_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Report, Watertight Integrity Status Bill (WISB) for Submarines
summary: The Watertight Integrity Status Bill provides the Navy with information to determine whether the shipbuilder is maintaining the watertight integrity status on all hull penetrations.
description_purpose: The Watertight Integrity Status Bill (WISB) provides the Navy with information to determine whether the shipbuilder is maintaining the watertight integrity status on all hull penetrations.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement(s) as delineated in the contract.

7.2 NAVSEA 0905-485-6010, Manual for the Control of Testing and Ship Conditions may be obtained from: Commanding Officer, Naval Publications and Forms Center, Attn: Code 3013, 5801 Tabor Avenue, Philadelphia, PA 19110

7.3 This DID supersedes UDI-T-26493.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including the approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be as specified in NAVSEA publication 0905-485-6010, Manual for the Control and Testing of Ship Conditions, and shall contain the following:

children.title: Draft, trim and list limits currently in effect and any permissible changes thereto.
Condition of hull penetrations and other factors affecting watertight integrity.
A description (drawing) of emergency communications, lighting and alarms together with the location of operating switches.
Backup and emergency shore electric power supplies.
A listing of hull penetrations below the control water plane as defined in the ship specifications.
The authorized methods of closure for each hull penetration.
A list of hull penetrations above the control water plane which are not in their normal, as-built condition, as shown on ship construction drawings.
The status of the sonar dome.
The current status of interior liquid tanks with capacity exceeding 150 cubic feet.
